ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
libgdal:
- '3.13'
libgdal_core:
- '3.13'
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: richdem
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.4.3"

package:
  name: richdem
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/giswqs/richdem2/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7bece67947a14e8b607aea8f6aa7cb56e928ab458ea709e2bfead170c7e8eb90

build:
  number: 1
  skip: ppc64le
  python:
    entry_points:
      - rd_depression_filling=richdem.cli:DepressionFilling
      - rd_breach_depressions=richdem.cli:BreachDepressions
      - rd_flow_accumulation=richdem.cli:FlowAccumulation
      - rd_terrain_attribute=richdem.cli:TerrainAttribute
      - rd_info=richdem.cli:RdInfo
      - rd_compare=richdem.cli:RdCompare

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - python
    - pybind11
    - libgdal
    - pip
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - numpy
    - libgdal-core
    - pybind11
    - setuptools
    - if: not win
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: win
      then: vcomp14
  run:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - libgdal-core
    - numpy
    - if: win
      then: vcomp14
  run_constraints:

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - _richdem
        - richdem
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - rd_depression_filling --help
      - rd_breach_depressions --help
      - rd_flow_accumulation --help
      - rd_terrain_attribute --help
      - rd_info --help
      - rd_compare --help

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: High-Performance Terrain Analysis
  homepage: https://github.com/r-barnes/richdem

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - r-barnes
    - mcflugen
    - ocefpaf
    - hobu
    - giswqs
